stem:
Each ticket to ride a carousel costs $2.50. The table shows the relationship between x, the number of tickets bought, and y, the cost of the tickets in dollars.

Carousel Rides

| Number of Tickets, x | Cost, y (dollars) |
|---------------------|-------------------|
| 1                   | 2.50              |
| 2                   | 5.00              |
| 3                   | 7.50              |
| 5                   | 12.50             |

Which graph best represents the data shown in the table?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph of Carousel Rides with points approximately at (1,3), (2,5), (3,8), (5,13)

options.label: H
options.text: Graph of Carousel Rides with points approximately at (1,2.5), (2,5), (3,7.5), (5,12)

options.label: G
options.text: Graph of Carousel Rides with points approximately at (1,2.5), (2,5), (3,7.5), (5,12.5)

options.label: J
options.text: Graph of Carousel Rides with points approximately at (1,2), (2,5), (3,7), (5,12)

visual_elements: Table with ticket number and cost
Four graphs labeled F, H, G, J showing scatter plots of number of tickets vs cost
notes: Option G best matches the data exactly from the table.
